exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Please let me do...".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
~させてください

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ~させてください matches "Please let me do...".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ~させてください.
exercises.explanation: Used to politely ask for permission to do something yourself.
